findings.description: Prior text presented '/usr/bin/python or python3 often points to an obsolete system Python 2' as a normal current macOS condition. Verified false against the current official Python 3.14 macOS documentation: modern macOS's /usr/bin/python3 is Apple-controlled Python 3 tooling (Xcode/Command Line Tools), not a Python-2 concern; the historical Python 2 default predates Catalina (2019). Also contained a mixed-script typo ("скриptами"). Corrected in scripts/build_chapter_02.py (section 2.3).
findings.resolution: scripts/build_chapter_02.py section 2.3 rewritten to state the current model (Apple-controlled /usr/bin/python3 tied to Xcode/Command Line Tools, usually older/incomplete, never to be modified or deleted) as primary fact, with the historical Python 2 default explicitly bounded to pre-2019 macOS versions; fixed the closing diagnostic paragraph to reference PATH ordering (2.4) and sys.executable (2.6) instead of a vague warning; fixed the mixed-script typo. Chapter 2 regenerated; verified against docs.python.org/3.14/using/mac.html.
